## Summary

Describe the route, component, provider, or documentation change.

## Provider and rights review

- [ ] Third-party API/media terms and licensing were reviewed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, accounts, or downloaded media are included
- [ ] Rate limits and failure states are handled

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant route tested in a browser
- [ ] Mobile and keyboard behavior reviewed
